body: The opening gap did not just hold, it EXTENDED: the S&P 500 is 7469.28, -1.22% on the day against the 7561.67 carried in the 6:00am brief, the Nasdaq is 24659.168, -1.90% versus 25136.273, the Dow 52043.32, -0.58% versus 52347.55, and the Russell 2000 2764.367, -0.94% versus 2790.49, while ES=F at 7490 is down another 42.25 since the 6:00am 7532.25 and NQ=F at 27425 is down another 214.25 from 27639.25 — meaning cash is through the 7500 first line of defense named in the plan and working toward the 7450 shelf as of Nov 16, 07:15 PT. Volatility confirmed the risk-off framing: VIX is 21.48, +11.36%, up 0.86 from the 20.62 banked at 6:00am, though the term structure NOW at VIX 21.48 − VIX3M 21.95 = -0.47 is still negative, i.e. contango and constructive, just far less cushioned than the last banked macro state (a prior session's close, as-of 2026-11-13: raw -1.54, smoothed -1.35, constructive). The 10-year is 5.121, -0.64%, slightly below the 5.133 in the 6:00am brief, so the rate side is not what is pressing equities here. Sector heat is concentrated in defensives — XLP +0.68%, XLV +0.63%, XLU +0.61%, XLRE +0.37% — against XLK -2.57%, XLC -1.33%, XLY -1.17% and XLE -1.60%; versus the earlier sector snapshot as-of Nov 16, 06:03 PT, tech deepened from -2.01%, and the green in XLF (+0.81% to -0.26%), XLE (+0.98% to -1.60%) and XLC (+1.05% to -1.33%) has flipped, so the breadth of the cushion has narrowed to pure defensives. The ±3% movers are almost entirely semis and AI-infrastructure: APLD -8.80%, SNDK -8.19%, MU -7.05%, MRVL -6.82%, ARM -6.59%, CRCL -6.40%, DELL -6.09%, CRWV -6.08%, VRT -5.99%, INTC -5.63%, TSM -5.61%, AVGO -4.67%, HOOD -4.42%, AMD -4.28%, RDDT -4.19%, CAVA -4.12%, PLTR -3.65%, TSLA -3.36%, MDB -3.72%, QUBT -4.95%, SMR -3.33%. On levels, NVDA 160.10 is AT OR THROUGH the lower band (fit 172.24, σ 7.8, z -1.56σ), as are QUBT at z -1.61σ, CRCL at -1.87σ, CAVA at -2.08σ and HD at -2.09σ, with KTOS (-1.47σ) and MSFT (-1.08σ) approaching the lower band and GOOGL (+1.03σ), APP (+1.20σ), CRWV (+1.08σ) and CEG (+1.43σ) approaching the upper band, all gates ±1.5σ over 30 completed daily closes through 2026-11-13. Scoring the 6:00am plan: the tech-led pullback, the VIX-near-21 jumpy tape and the named avoid APLD (-8.80%) are CONFIRMED, the defensive rotation is partially confirmed through XLV, XLP and XLU but the value cushion from financials and energy is CONTRADICTED by XLF -0.26% and XLE -1.60%, and the named opportunity UNH is UNTESTED — no UNH price appears in this snapshot, so I cannot score it; likewise the 7450 shelf is approached but untested from one observation. No macro releases are scheduled in the tracked Fed/BLS calendar for today, and this read holds no released figures.
